exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Giving something".

options.text: Noun を あげる
A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Noun を あげる matches "Giving something".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Noun を あげる.
exercises.explanation: Used to say you give something or do a favor for someone else.
